_comment: AD-104: a farm's field grows by 9x9 modules, each with one water source at its centre, so all 80 plots of a module are hydrated (vanilla: water within 4 blocks). Coordinates are local to the farm building (the 7x7 farmhouse stands at 0..6, 0..6). A module (mx,mz) spans x origin.x+9mx..+8 and z origin.z+9mz..+8; its water is at +water. A level lists the modules it adds; a farm's field is every module of its levels. Targets are the residents the owner wants each level to feed; rated residents = floor(wheat per day / rating_divisor) (2 bread per resident per day plus a quarter spare).
_comment_ad130: AD-130 (owner 2026-09-22): schema 2. levels are the fields (9x9 modules [mx,mz,floor]) each farm level adds: I one field, II a 2x2, III a 2x3 away from the farmhouse, IV a barn over the 2x3 with a second floor of 6 fields, V a third floor (18 fields), VI no new land (the machine works all 18). A floor's ground lies floor_pitch blocks above the one below (decks at y4 and y9, 3 blocks of air per floor); its fields cost upper_soil_per_module of upper_soil_item and the slab. legacy_levels is the AD-104 table: villages laid before layout 6 keep it (their farms keep their old land and work it as before). reserve is the barn's final footprint (farm-local x0,z0,x1,z1, east).
_comment_p4: AD-112 (AD-104 P4): the field grows with the land its builders lay. reserved_level is how much land world generation and lots keep clear around a farm; cover_item is the one item a new module costs (the slab over its water); its ground and water are the builders' own work.
_comment_farmers: AD-130: farmers a farm kept at I..VI posts (the kept level, not the working one); at VI the machine sows and reaps every field and the porters bring its seed and bone meal and take the harvest (owner 2026-09-22: no farmer).
